note_en: 一年比一年 means "more every year," placed before an adjective: 马拉松比赛更是一年比一年火爆 "marathons are getting hotter year by year." The pattern 一 + time word + 比 + 一 + time word works for any unit (一天比一天, 一次比一次) and already implies steady change, so English "more and more" or "by the year" carries it better than a literal comparison.
